Ketotifen, an antihistamine, is indicated for Vernal Conjunctivitis and is used to alleviate symptoms such as redness and swelling. The indirect pathway implies that Loteprednol Etabonate may exert its effects on Papillary Conjunctivitis through the modulation of inflammatory pathways that are also targeted by Ketotifen.
